intro: Spacious and stunning, our Magnitude table offers classic elegance and generous seating—made for large families, long conversations, and heartfelt meals.

features.title: Timeless mahogany finish
features.text: Warm mahogany tones bring a classic richness to your dining area, offering a welcoming and traditional feel.

features.title: Full solid wood build
features.text: Crafted entirely from solid rubberwood, this table combines elegance with enduring strength for years of dependable use.

features.title: Insect- and wear-resistant
features.text: Seasoned wood resists pests and environmental wear, helping your table stay sturdy, safe, and beautiful over time.

features.title: Comfort-focused leg design
features.text: Angular legs placed at the ends create open legroom for up to 8 people, ensuring comfort during big family meals and festive feasts.

features.title: Room for everyone
features.text: Its spacious surface comfortably seats eight, making it perfect for hosting dinners, celebrations, or everyday family time.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
